scope_note: Real-browser verification only of rejection paths, rendering, CSP/console/network behavior and layout. The password was not known and was not guessed, cracked, or bypassed; no exploit scripts were run against the gates.

checks.expected: Sealed payload received; no password-looking value in any request

checks.action: Read CSP meta via eval on live pages; curl -sI for HTTP security headers
checks.expected: CSP behavior recorded; no CSP violations in console
checks.observed: GitHub Pages serves no CSP HTTP header (only strict-transport-security: max-age=31556952); CSP is delivered via <meta http-equiv='Content-Security-Policy'>. Console gate meta CSP: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; connect-src 'self'" (page has 1 inline script + 1 inline style, which is why unsafe-inline is present). Cockpit meta CSP (stricter): "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.steemit.com https://api.justyy.com https://steem.61bts.com https://api.hive.blog https://api.deathwing.me; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'". Zero CSP violations appeared in the browser console during any interaction.

NOT VERIFIED — agent-3d holds no password and was forbidden from guessing/cracking/bypassing it. The correct-password path (vault opening, content rendering post-auth) is explicitly out of scope for this receipt.

findings.observed: GET /favicon.ico returns 404 on the console gate (browser auto-request). Cosmetic only; no functional impact.

findings.action: CSP meta inspection vs cockpit CSP
findings.observed: Console gate CSP allows script-src 'unsafe-inline' / style-src 'unsafe-inline' (required by its single-file inline-script architecture), while the cockpit gate enforces the stricter script-src 'self'. Defense-in-depth inconsistency; NO exploit or injection was observed — the XSS payload string in the input was treated purely as key material and never executed.

On first load the cockpit password input and submit button render [disabled] for roughly 2–3 seconds (apparent boot/sealed-payload fetch phase), then enable. Informational UX note, not a defect; subsequent interactions behaved normally.

Cockpit CSP connect-src allows five external blockchain RPC hosts (api.steemit.com, api.justyy.com, steem.61bts.com, api.hive.blog, api.deathwing.me). None were contacted during this verification (request log shows only same-origin static assets). Recorded for the swarm's awareness; no observed traffic to those hosts from the gates.

limits: The correct-password unlock path could not be verified: no password was available and attempting to guess, crack, or bypass the gates is forbidden. Post-unlock content rendering is unverified.

Sealed payload files (params.json, sealed-payload.bin, vault.enc.json) were confirmed by name, HTTP method and status only; their bodies were not inspected or decrypted (and decryption was not attempted).

The 'no password-looking value in any request' check is based on the tracked request list (methods, URLs, no query strings, static GETs only); agent-browser network request detail returned only the URL, so header-level inspection was done via curl for HTTP security headers (HSTS present, no CSP HTTP header on GitHub Pages — CSP is via meta tag).

No active CSP-violation or injection probe was run against the pages (that would constitute an exploit attempt and is forbidden); CSP verification is limited to reading the delivered policy and observing zero console violations during normal interactions.
Cockpit initial disabled-state duration (~2–3s) is an approximate human-observed timing, not a measured benchmark.
Testing performed in a single headless Chromium (agent-browser default); other engines/browsers were not tested.
honesty_note: All 'observed' fields record exactly what agent-browser returned. No dialog ever opened during the XSS-string tests; no console or page errors appeared at any point; browser closed cleanly via 'agent-browser close'. No repo files were edited, nothing committed or pushed, worklog.md untouched.
